decisions.reason: As a low-cost incremental component embedded in the core radiant-heating business, it is likely to be retained because modest underperformance can be absorbed within the firm's growth and organisational slack.

Even after pruning Product D, this flagship electric line remains central to the firm's lower-carbon direction, so management would keep it and continue learning unless results clearly fall below aspirations.
After the earlier withdrawal of D, this less strategic electric heater is the clearest candidate for problemistic search and resource reallocation if its performance remains below aspiration levels.

Because this hydrogen-capable line is strategically important, close to the core business, and already shown in real operation, any shortfall would more likely trigger refinement than discontinuation.
